mechanism: Both drugs can cause gastrointestinal irritation and ulceration; alendronate requires specific administration precautions (upright position, empty stomach) that may be compromised by concurrent use of raloxifene which also affects GI tolerability.
action: Separate administration times by at least 2 hours; ensure alendronate is taken on empty stomach in upright position; monitor for GI symptoms including dysphagia, esophageal ulceration, and abdominal pain.
